instruction: Export the current Impress presentation to PDF format and save it as presentation.pdf on the Desktop. Use default settings.

metadata.explanation: Checks if the PDF export exists and has a minimum size of 5KB. PDF is a common export format for presentations. Verified: Similar export task complexity as original.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts file existence and size from the specified path using standard get_vm_file pattern
Metric implements sound progressive scoring logic: 0.5 for file existence, additional 0.5 for size requirement
Complete instruction coverage: verifies file name (presentation.pdf), location (/home/user/Desktop/), and validity (min 5KB size)
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict with exists/size, metric compares against expected values
Expected values are semantically correct: should_exist=true and min_size=5000 bytes is reasonable for PDF presentations
No UI state dependencies: file check works post-export without requiring dialogs to be open
Postconfig includes appropriate 1-second sleep for file system stabilization
Error handling is robust: getter handles exceptions gracefully and returns safe default values
